enemies.name: Space Barracuda
descriptions: Will periodically bend space and teleport to a new location.
Fires ranged projectiles of quantum energy.
enemies.behavior: The seven-second cycle performs an authoritative radius-eight blink and launches the recovered spacetime/energy projectile.

enemies.name: Cannonator
descriptions: Fires a large slow moving projectile when at a distance from his target.
When engaging in close combat, will switch to close range melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: Authored phase order selects the slow projectile beyond eight units and melee at eight or nearer.

enemies.name: Reparatron
descriptions: Repairs nearby fallen robots, bringing them back to life if given enough time.
Can use its repair tools as melee weapons if given the opportunity.
enemies.behavior: It resurrects an eligible nearby robot through the repair channel and otherwise attacks with Arc Welding melee.

enemies.name: Pack Brawler
descriptions: Believes in the safety of numbers and will cower if alone.
Once an ally is nearby, will work up the courage to deliver a powerful melee attack.
enemies.behavior: It cowers without a living ally inside the authored 20-unit check and admits its ranked melee when supported.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.
enemies.behavior: It deterministically selects the nearest living ally inside range 30, falls back to itself only when alone, applies the exact 20-second movement/attack/cooldown haste, then fires its recovered projectile.

enemies.name: Decelerator
descriptions: Can instantly inflict a crippling debuff on nearby heroes, slowing their movement and attack speed.
Chases after slowed heroes and uses a physical melee attack.
enemies.behavior: Its six-second slow now enters the modifier inventory, reaches the client with the exact movement and attack operands, and contributes its movement operand to authoritative hero motion before the melee pursuit.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.
enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Scorpiod
descriptions: Fast moving, closes in for quick melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: It pursues at the authored eight-unit combat speed and repeats its recovered physical melee on a 1.5-second cooldown.

enemies.name: Homing Striker
descriptions: Fires projectiles that periodically home in on the closest hero.
The projectiles will expire after a short period of time.
enemies.behavior: Its retained-target projectile begins homing after one second and is bounded by the authored 18-unit lifetime.

enemies.name: Tentacler
descriptions: Causes spiky thorns to emerge from underneath a hero..
Damage can be avoided by staying mobile.
enemies.behavior: It snapshots the hero’s position, warns there after one second, and damages only actors still inside the strict two-unit radius at 2.5 seconds.

enemies.name: Warp Spawner
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.
enemies.behavior: Incoming area damage is reduced by 75 percent and a successful projectile hit performs the recovered random reachable-position teleport.

enemies.name: Magnetic Master
descriptions: Support enemy who tries to stay away from close combat.
Mastery of gravity allows him to pull heroes towards his friends.
Can send out a circular gravitational push that damages and knocks back all nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: It pulls a distant retained hero toward its formation and switches at five units or nearer to the seven-unit damaging push, displacing every admitted nearby hero away from itself.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.
enemies.behavior: Its acid projectile, rank-shaped Energy Defense, bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle movement, half-health Physical-immunity Turtle phase, and ranked poison pulses are active.

enemies.name: Draining Simian
descriptions: Can drain health over time if it gets close enough to its target.
Becomes exhausted for a short time after stealing a significant amount of health.
enemies.behavior: Its close-range eight-tick channel heals from committed damage, then its authored channel lifecycle releases before the next attack.

enemies.name: Necrodactyl
descriptions: The curse deals damage over time, but has a limit on how much it can stack.
enemies.behavior: Projectile impacts apply the six-second curse, repeated hits refresh it and stack its damage only to the authored maximum of three.

enemies.name: Necrotic Leech
descriptions: Fires long range necro projectiles.
Will regain health when nearby allies are damaged.
enemies.behavior: It uses the ranked long-range supernatural projectile and its nearby-allied-damage listener heals it from committed damage.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.
enemies.behavior: It revives the nearest eligible encounter corpse at 40 percent health; without one, it backs away from a close hero and fires the ranked GhostlyBolt projectile before checking for another corpse. The flee pursuit is an explicit secondary phase, so the primary resurrection-family guard no longer releases it as incompatible.

enemies.name: Pyro
descriptions: Has a short range fire breath attack that can hit multiple targets within its area.
enemies.behavior: Fire Breath evaluates all heroes and targetable companions inside its 120-degree, rank-shaped cone.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Attacks with energy damage when up close.
explodes upon death.
Charges its target, explodes upon death
enemies.behavior: Footprint-aware charge pursuit hands off to Smash at close range without rejecting that secondary melee phase, and death starts cast_explode before the recovered 1.3-second, seven-unit elemental-energy detonation at the defeated world position.

enemies.name: Muting Leucopod
descriptions: Will sometimes strafe between attacks.
enemies.behavior: Its slow projectile and two-second Silence are followed by one bounded navigation-clipped lateral strafe or a short idle before the next attack.

enemies.name: Vampiric Leaper
descriptions: Hopping area effect attack
enemies.behavior: Its authored leap lands with a four-unit area attack against every admitted hero and targetable companion.

enemies.name: Pterodyne
descriptions: Will stealth in an attempt to move in close.
Melee attacks cause the hero to become vulnerable to future physical damage.
enemies.behavior: Stealth Attack relocates into its target-relative band and chains Fear Nova; its ordinary melee applies the ranked charge-limited Physical Vulnerability modifier.

enemies.name: Carrion Shambler
descriptions: Can consume the corpses of its allies to become larger and stronger.
Uses its large fists to smash heroes in melee range.
enemies.behavior: It claims and consumes eligible allied corpses, gaining stacked damage and body scale, and otherwise uses its multi-target frontal melee.

enemies.name: Pathogenic Vegevore
descriptions: Fires projectiles that inflicts a disease that can jump between nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its projectile can apply the ranked disease, whose retained run spreads among nearby heroes subject to the authored immunity interval.

enemies.name: Pouncing Stalker
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.
enemies.behavior: It chooses the authored leap outside Swipe range and its persistent self-resurrection sign now consumes the first lethal hit, restores it at 40 percent health, and resumes combat once.

enemies.name: Swarming Herbipod
descriptions: Stationary until threatened; launches slow, relentlessly homing attacks.
enemies.behavior: Zero locomotion keeps the turret stationary, its aggro presentation activates it, and its bounded projectile uses delayed retained-target homing with terminal cleanup even when the target becomes invalid or takes no damage.

enemies.name: Pathogenic Vegevore
descriptions: Disease projectile can jump between nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-4.

enemies.name: Botanical Tunneler
descriptions: Tunnels close underground, then emerges with a poison area attack.
enemies.behavior: Its burrow animation and temporary intangibility accompany pursuit into the eight-unit radial Stagnant Nova.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pull victims are slowed, then struck with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: The three-second Pulled modifier owns the forced-movement interval, then the phase uses the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe while Puller cools.

enemies.name: Toxiraptor
descriptions: Connected melee attacks can inject poison.
enemies.behavior: Every accepted surviving hit rolls the ranked chance and applies or refreshes the authored damage-over-time modifier.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis
descriptions: Lobs a small sleeping cloud, then closes on sleeping heroes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Sleep Mushroom creates the three-tick radius-two cloud and close targets switch to Rez Melee.

enemies.name: Dynosphere
descriptions: Straightforward melee protected by a periodically recharging absorption shield.
enemies.behavior: Its frontal melee is unchanged and its visible rank-shaped absorption shield recharges after 12/10/8 seconds.

enemies.name: Fragbot Mech
descriptions: Highly resistant to energy damage; attacks with rapid-fire machine guns.
enemies.behavior: It publishes rank-shaped 250/500/750 Energy Defense and fires its recovered five-shot burst.

enemies.name: Reconstructionist
descriptions: Ground slam knocks nearby heroes upward; when damaged, repairs itself.
enemies.behavior: Its phase chooses ranked self-repair while wounded, otherwise radial Ground Slam or close Piston Punch.

enemies.name: Reparatron
descriptions: Repairs fallen robots and can use its tools as melee weapons.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-1.

enemies.name: Pack Brawler
descriptions: Cowers alone and uses powerful melee when an ally is nearby.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-1.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Piercing lasers cross multiple heroes; buffs nearby allies’ energy damage.
enemies.behavior: The piercing path damages each contact once and resolves at the selected target, while the support branch applies one ranked Energy Damage buff per 30-second modifier cycle.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Uses energy damage at close range.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-3.

enemies.name: Dread Root
descriptions: Melee attacks can root their victim, allowing allies to close in.
enemies.behavior: Accepted attacks make the ranked root roll and publish the timed root lifecycle.

enemies.name: Menace Weed
descriptions: Roots to channel healing near allies; otherwise fires rapid thorns.
enemies.behavior: The ally-dependent phase selects its repeated six-unit heal aura or its ranked multishot Thorn Dart.

enemies.name: Caustic Stinger
descriptions: Circles its target and periodically darts in for a fast sting.
enemies.behavior: Navigation-clipped circle movement alternates with the recovered Darting Attack.

enemies.name: Botanical Tunneler
descriptions: Tunnels close underground, then emerges with a poison area attack.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 2-1.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals damaged allies; roots heroes and calls nearby friends to focus them.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 2-1.

enemies.name: Ragetusk
descriptions: Charges and knocks heroes up; grows and deals more damage when nearby allies die.
enemies.behavior: The existing charge and knock-up remain, while each nearby allied death now adds a bounded damage and body-size enrage stack.

enemies.name: Undermind
descriptions: Ignites heroes, increases their Energy vulnerability, and gives allies a fiery buff.
enemies.behavior: Its fiery strike applies burning and stacking Energy vulnerability and projects the allied Energy-damage buff.

enemies.name: Distracted Mongrel
descriptions: Fast melee attacker that is easily distracted.
enemies.behavior: Its recovered fast melee cadence includes the exact one-percent distraction delay.

enemies.name: Stealth Slayer
descriptions: Appears from stealth beside heroes, then fights in melee.
enemies.behavior: It spawns stealthed, reveals on its first accepted attack or hit, and pursues into close melee.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Necrotic Leech
descriptions: Fires long-range necro projectiles and heals when nearby allies take damage.
enemies.behavior: Its projectile is unchanged and every committed nearby allied hit now heals it for a bounded fraction of that damage.

enemies.name: Pterodyne
descriptions: Stealths to close distance; melee causes future Physical vulnerability.
enemies.behavior: Stealth Attack closes from range and its follow-up melee applies the hit-count vulnerability.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis
descriptions: Lobs a sleeping cloud, then closes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 2-1.

enemies.name: Pyro
descriptions: Short-range fire breath can hit multiple targets.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-3.

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
descriptions: Fires slow ranged projectiles and strafes sideways between attacks.
enemies.behavior: Ranked Poison Spit alternates with one bounded navigation-clipped lateral strafe or a short idle before the next attack.

enemies.name: Pincering Carapace
descriptions: Uses physical melee and sometimes charges up so its next attack deals more damage and knockback.
enemies.behavior: Its standard melee alternates with ranked Build Charge and a stored Discharge strike, and death removes any unused charge attachment.

enemies.name: Sting Raider
descriptions: Fast flying swarm attacker whose shifted form strongly resists area attacks.
enemies.behavior: Its fast close melee remains and an area hit now activates the shifted state on the correct noun family, reducing subsequent area damage while active.

enemies.name: Cannonator
descriptions: Fires a large slow projectile at range and switches to melee nearby.

descriptions: Causes spiky thorns to emerge from underneath a hero..
Damage can be avoided by staying mobile.
enemies.behavior: It snapshots the hero’s position, warns there after one second, and damages only actors still inside the strict two-unit radius at 2.5 seconds.

enemies.name: Chrono Striker
descriptions: Tail strikes slow movement and attacks; it flees when nearby members of its species die.
enemies.behavior: Its melee applies the timed movement/attack slow, while the nearby-death counter drives its navigation-clipped flee phase.

descriptions: Tunnels close underground, then emerges with a poison area attack.
enemies.behavior: Its burrow animation and temporary intangibility accompany pursuit into the eight-unit radial Stagnant Nova.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pull victims are slowed, then struck with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: The three-second Pulled modifier owns the forced-movement interval, then the phase uses the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe while Puller cools.

descriptions: Lobs a small sleeping cloud, then closes on sleeping heroes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Sleep Mushroom creates the three-tick radius-two cloud and close targets switch to Rez Melee.

enemies.name: Cannonator
descriptions: Fires a large slow moving projectile when at a distance from his target.
When engaging in close combat, will switch to close range melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: Authored phase order selects the slow projectile beyond eight units and melee at eight or nearer.

enemies.name: Warp Spawner
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.
enemies.behavior: Incoming area damage is reduced by 75 percent and a successful projectile hit performs the recovered random reachable-position teleport.

descriptions: Has high dodge and damages every hero touched during its charge.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating participates in avoidance and its clipped through-target charge resolves every path contact.

descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.
enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

descriptions: Charges and knocks heroes up; grows and deals more damage when nearby allies die.

descriptions: Attacks with energy damage when up close.
explodes upon death.
Charges its target, explodes upon death
enemies.behavior: Footprint-aware charge pursuit hands off to Smash at close range without rejecting that secondary melee phase, and death starts cast_explode before the recovered 1.3-second, seven-unit elemental-energy detonation at the defeated world position.

enemies.name: Fragbot Mech
descriptions: Highly resistant to energy damage; attacks with rapid-fire machine guns.
enemies.behavior: It publishes rank-shaped 250/500/750 Energy Defense and fires its recovered five-shot burst.

enemies.name: Robo-bomber
descriptions: Rolls grenades toward a target point where they explode in an area.
enemies.behavior: The rolling retained grenade detonates at its destination and damages every admitted area target.

enemies.name: Laser Tank
descriptions: Highly resists Energy damage and fires up to three sustained laser beams.
enemies.behavior: It now publishes rank-shaped Energy Defense and its recovered cone zone sustains up to three one-second target pulses.

enemies.name: Reconstructionist
descriptions: Ground slam knocks nearby heroes upward; when damaged, repairs itself.
enemies.behavior: Its phase chooses ranked self-repair while wounded, otherwise radial Ground Slam or close Piston Punch.

enemies.name: Shielded Grenadier
descriptions: Frontal shield blocks damage; lobs cluster grenades and knocks back close frontal heroes.
enemies.behavior: Directional shield admission, cluster submunitions, and the close bash all use their recovered phases.

enemies.name: Undermind
descriptions: Ignites heroes, increases their Energy vulnerability, and gives allies a fiery buff.
enemies.behavior: Its fiery strike applies burning and stacking Energy vulnerability and projects the allied Energy-damage buff.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.
enemies.behavior: Its acid projectile, rank-shaped Energy Defense, bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle movement, half-health Physical-immunity Turtle phase, and ranked poison pulses are active.

enemies.name: Lightning Stalker
descriptions: Slow-moving long-range orb shooter whose hits can briefly shock.
enemies.behavior: Its ranked projectile carries the authored shock chance and timed stun modifier.

enemies.name: Ray Killer
descriptions: Fires one fast horizontal piercing bolt per target in range and flees when struck.
enemies.behavior: A cast now targets every live hero or companion in range with its own piercing bolt, and an accepted incoming hit queues a navigation-clipped flee before the next volley.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Attacks with energy damage when up close.
explodes upon death.
Charges its target, explodes upon death
enemies.behavior: Footprint-aware charge pursuit hands off to Smash at close range without rejecting that secondary melee phase, and death starts cast_explode before the recovered 1.3-second, seven-unit elemental-energy detonation at the defeated world position.

explodes upon death.

enemies.name: Electron Burster
descriptions: Instant lightning attack fizzles against nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its phase maintains the recovered minimum range, publishes the fizzle when crowded, and otherwise fires the instant beam.

enemies.name: Toxiraptor
descriptions: Connected melee attacks can inject poison.
enemies.behavior: Every accepted surviving hit rolls the ranked chance and applies or refreshes the authored damage-over-time modifier.

enemies.name: Quadrakiller
descriptions: Fires lightning-orb volleys and becomes exhausted briefly afterward.
enemies.behavior: Its recovered four-shot burst retains the long release/exhaustion interval before the next action.

enemies.name: Terrorsaur
descriptions: Throws a spread of fireballs that ignite heroes.
enemies.behavior: Ranked spread angles each resolve independently and accepted hits apply the burning damage-over-time modifier.

enemies.name: Ray Killer
descriptions: Fires one fast horizontal piercing bolt per target in range and flees when struck.
enemies.behavior: A cast now targets every live hero or companion in range with its own piercing bolt, and an accepted incoming hit queues a navigation-clipped flee before the next volley.

enemies.name: Ghostly Tracker
descriptions: Has high dodge and damages every hero touched during its charge.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating participates in avoidance and its clipped through-target charge resolves every path contact.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Pterodyne
descriptions: Will stealth in an attempt to move in close.
Melee attacks cause the hero to become vulnerable to future physical damage.
enemies.behavior: Stealth Attack relocates into its target-relative band and chains Fear Nova; its ordinary melee applies the ranked charge-limited Physical Vulnerability modifier.

enemies.name: Molten Crawler
descriptions: Hurls magma at nearby heroes to create damaging lava pools and uses melee close up.
enemies.behavior: Its phase selects per-target retained lava pools or the recovered melee fallback.

enemies.name: Pouncing Stalker
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.
enemies.behavior: It chooses the authored leap outside Swipe range and its persistent self-resurrection sign now consumes the first lethal hit, restores it at 40 percent health, and resumes combat once.

enemies.name: Dimensionist
descriptions: Creates a lasting sphere that slows heroes and projectiles, then calls debris down while protected.
enemies.behavior: Slow Shield uses a removable 16-second globe, Meteor flows into the authored 12-unit target-facing strafe, distant targets are pursued, and the intermediate range admits either packaged laugh/taunt animation.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.
enemies.behavior: It revives the nearest eligible encounter corpse at 40 percent health; without one, it backs away from a close hero and fires the ranked GhostlyBolt projectile before checking for another corpse. The flee pursuit is an explicit secondary phase, so the primary resurrection-family guard no longer releases it as incompatible.

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
descriptions: Fires slow ranged projectiles and strafes sideways between attacks.
enemies.behavior: Ranked Poison Spit alternates with one bounded navigation-clipped lateral strafe or a short idle before the next attack.

descriptions: Slow-moving long-range orb shooter whose hits can briefly shock.
enemies.behavior: Its ranked projectile carries the authored shock chance and timed stun modifier.

descriptions: Fires lightning-orb volleys and becomes exhausted briefly afterward.

enemies.name: Ray Killer
descriptions: Fires one fast horizontal piercing bolt per target in range and flees when struck.

enemies.name: Sting Raider
descriptions: Fast flying swarm attacker whose shifted form strongly resists area attacks.
enemies.behavior: Its fast close melee remains and an area hit now activates the shifted state on the correct noun family, reducing subsequent area damage while active.

enemies.name: Homing Striker
descriptions: Fires projectiles that periodically home in on the closest hero.
The projectiles will expire after a short period of time.
enemies.behavior: Its retained-target projectile begins homing after one second and is bounded by the authored 18-unit lifetime.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.
enemies.behavior: It deterministically selects the nearest living ally inside range 30, falls back to itself only when alone, applies the exact 20-second movement/attack/cooldown haste, then fires its recovered projectile.

enemies.name: Laser Unit
descriptions: Charges up, then fires a piercing laser bolt.
enemies.behavior: Its ranked wind-up leads into a range-extended piercing projectile.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pull victims are slowed, then struck with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: The three-second Pulled modifier owns the forced-movement interval, then the phase uses the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe while Puller cools.

enemies.name: Molten Crawler
descriptions: Hurls magma at nearby heroes to create damaging lava pools and uses melee close up.
enemies.behavior: Its phase selects per-target retained lava pools or the recovered melee fallback.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.
enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Decelerator
descriptions: Can instantly inflict a crippling debuff on nearby heroes, slowing their movement and attack speed.
Chases after slowed heroes and uses a physical melee attack.
enemies.behavior: Its six-second slow now enters the modifier inventory, reaches the client with the exact movement and attack operands, and contributes its movement operand to authoritative hero motion before the melee pursuit.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.
enemies.behavior: Its acid projectile, rank-shaped Energy Defense, bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle movement, half-health Physical-immunity Turtle phase, and ranked poison pulses are active.

explodes upon death.

descriptions: The curse deals damage over time, but has a limit on how much it can stack.
enemies.behavior: Projectile impacts apply the six-second curse, repeated hits refresh it and stack its damage only to the authored maximum of three.

enemies.name: Necrotic Leech
descriptions: Fires long range necro projectiles.
Will regain health when nearby allies are damaged.
enemies.behavior: It uses the ranked long-range supernatural projectile and its nearby-allied-damage listener heals it from committed damage.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.
enemies.behavior: It revives the nearest eligible encounter corpse at 40 percent health; without one, it backs away from a close hero and fires the ranked GhostlyBolt projectile before checking for another corpse. The flee pursuit is an explicit secondary phase, so the primary resurrection-family guard no longer releases it as incompatible.

enemies.name: Electron Burster
descriptions: Instant lightning attack fizzles against nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its phase maintains the recovered minimum range, publishes the fizzle when crowded, and otherwise fires the instant beam.

enemies.name: Quadrakiller
descriptions: Fires lightning-orb volleys and becomes exhausted briefly afterward.
enemies.behavior: Its recovered four-shot burst retains the long release/exhaustion interval before the next action.

enemies.name: Terrorsaur
descriptions: Throws a spread of fireballs that ignite heroes.
enemies.behavior: Ranked spread angles each resolve independently and accepted hits apply the burning damage-over-time modifier.

enemies.name: Sting Raider
descriptions: Fast flying swarm attacker whose shifted form strongly resists area attacks.
enemies.behavior: Its fast close melee remains and an area hit now activates the shifted state on the correct noun family, reducing subsequent area damage while active.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Piercing lasers cross multiple heroes; buffs nearby allies’ energy damage.
enemies.behavior: The piercing path damages each contact once and resolves at the selected target, while the support branch applies one ranked Energy Damage buff per 30-second modifier cycle.

enemies.name: Undermind
descriptions: Ignites heroes, increases their Energy vulnerability, and gives allies a fiery buff.
enemies.behavior: Its fiery strike applies burning and stacking Energy vulnerability and projects the allied Energy-damage buff.

enemies.name: Dimensionist
descriptions: Creates a lasting sphere that slows heroes and projectiles, then calls debris down while protected.
enemies.behavior: Slow Shield uses a removable 16-second globe, Meteor flows into the authored 12-unit target-facing strafe, distant targets are pursued, and the intermediate range admits either packaged laugh/taunt animation.

enemies.name: Stealth Slayer
descriptions: Appears from stealth beside heroes, then fights in melee.
enemies.behavior: It spawns stealthed, reveals on its first accepted attack or hit, and pursues into close melee.

enemies.name: Draining Simian
descriptions: Can drain health over time if it gets close enough to its target.
Becomes exhausted for a short time after stealing a significant amount of health.
enemies.behavior: Its close-range eight-tick channel heals from committed damage, then its authored channel lifecycle releases before the next attack.

enemies.name: Vampiric Leaper
descriptions: Hopping area effect attack
enemies.behavior: Its authored leap lands with a four-unit area attack against every admitted hero and targetable companion.

enemies.name: Carrion Shambler
descriptions: Can consume the corpses of its allies to become larger and stronger.
Uses its large fists to smash heroes in melee range.
enemies.behavior: It claims and consumes eligible allied corpses, gaining stacked damage and body scale, and otherwise uses its multi-target frontal melee.

enemies.name: Necrotic Leech
descriptions: Fires long range necro projectiles.
Will regain health when nearby allies are damaged.
enemies.behavior: It uses the ranked long-range supernatural projectile and its nearby-allied-damage listener heals it from committed damage.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.
enemies.behavior: It revives the nearest eligible encounter corpse at 40 percent health; without one, it backs away from a close hero and fires the ranked GhostlyBolt projectile before checking for another corpse. The flee pursuit is an explicit secondary phase, so the primary resurrection-family guard no longer releases it as incompatible.

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
descriptions: Fires slow ranged projectiles and strafes sideways between attacks.
enemies.behavior: Ranked Poison Spit alternates with one bounded navigation-clipped lateral strafe or a short idle before the next attack.

enemies.name: Tentacler
descriptions: Causes spiky thorns to emerge from underneath a hero..
Damage can be avoided by staying mobile.
enemies.behavior: It snapshots the hero’s position, warns there after one second, and damages only actors still inside the strict two-unit radius at 2.5 seconds.

enemies.name: Caustic Stinger
descriptions: Circles its target and periodically darts in for a fast sting.
enemies.behavior: Navigation-clipped circle movement alternates with the recovered Darting Attack.

enemies.name: Menace Weed
descriptions: Roots to channel healing near allies; otherwise fires rapid thorns.
enemies.behavior: The ally-dependent phase selects its repeated six-unit heal aura or its ranked multishot Thorn Dart.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Reparatron
descriptions: Repairs nearby fallen robots, bringing them back to life if given enough time.
Can use its repair tools as melee weapons if given the opportunity.
enemies.behavior: It resurrects an eligible nearby robot through the repair channel and otherwise attacks with Arc Welding melee.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.
enemies.behavior: Its acid projectile, rank-shaped Energy Defense, bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle movement, half-health Physical-immunity Turtle phase, and ranked poison pulses are active.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.
enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Pouncing Stalker
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.
enemies.behavior: It chooses the authored leap outside Swipe range and its persistent self-resurrection sign now consumes the first lethal hit, restores it at 40 percent health, and resumes combat once.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis
descriptions: Lobs a small sleeping cloud, then closes on sleeping heroes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Sleep Mushroom creates the three-tick radius-two cloud and close targets switch to Rez Melee.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pull victims are slowed, then struck with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: The three-second Pulled modifier owns the forced-movement interval, then the phase uses the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe while Puller cools.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.
enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Undermind
descriptions: Ignites heroes, increases their Energy vulnerability, and gives allies a fiery buff.
enemies.behavior: Its fiery strike applies burning and stacking Energy vulnerability and projects the allied Energy-damage buff.

enemies.name: Decelerator
descriptions: Can instantly inflict a crippling debuff on nearby heroes, slowing their movement and attack speed.
Chases after slowed heroes and uses a physical melee attack.
enemies.behavior: Its six-second slow now enters the modifier inventory, reaches the client with the exact movement and attack operands, and contributes its movement operand to authoritative hero motion before the melee pursuit.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Cannonator
descriptions: Fires a large slow moving projectile when at a distance from his target.
When engaging in close combat, will switch to close range melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: Authored phase order selects the slow projectile beyond eight units and melee at eight or nearer.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.
enemies.behavior: It deterministically selects the nearest living ally inside range 30, falls back to itself only when alone, applies the exact 20-second movement/attack/cooldown haste, then fires its recovered projectile.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Piercing lasers cross multiple heroes; buffs nearby allies’ energy damage.
enemies.behavior: The piercing path damages each contact once and resolves at the selected target, while the support branch applies one ranked Energy Damage buff per 30-second modifier cycle.

enemies.name: Lightning Stalker
descriptions: Slow-moving long-range orb shooter whose hits can briefly shock.
enemies.behavior: Its ranked projectile carries the authored shock chance and timed stun modifier.

enemies.name: Quadrakiller
descriptions: Fires lightning-orb volleys and becomes exhausted briefly afterward.
enemies.behavior: Its recovered four-shot burst retains the long release/exhaustion interval before the next action.

enemies.name: Swarming Herbipod
descriptions: Stationary until threatened; launches slow, relentlessly homing attacks.
enemies.behavior: Zero locomotion keeps the turret stationary, its aggro presentation activates it, and its bounded projectile uses delayed retained-target homing with terminal cleanup even when the target becomes invalid or takes no damage.

enemies.name: Pathogenic Vegevore
descriptions: Disease projectile can jump between nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-4.

enemies.name: Botanical Tunneler
descriptions: Tunnels close underground, then emerges with a poison area attack.
enemies.behavior: Its burrow animation and temporary intangibility accompany pursuit into the eight-unit radial Stagnant Nova.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pull victims are slowed, then struck with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: The three-second Pulled modifier owns the forced-movement interval, then the phase uses the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe while Puller cools.

enemies.name: Toxiraptor
descriptions: Connected melee attacks can inject poison.
enemies.behavior: Every accepted surviving hit rolls the ranked chance and applies or refreshes the authored damage-over-time modifier.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis
descriptions: Lobs a small sleeping cloud, then closes on sleeping heroes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Sleep Mushroom creates the three-tick radius-two cloud and close targets switch to Rez Melee.

enemies.name: Dynosphere
descriptions: Straightforward melee protected by a periodically recharging absorption shield.
enemies.behavior: Its frontal melee is unchanged and its visible rank-shaped absorption shield recharges after 12/10/8 seconds.

enemies.name: Fragbot Mech
descriptions: Highly resistant to energy damage; attacks with rapid-fire machine guns.
enemies.behavior: It publishes rank-shaped 250/500/750 Energy Defense and fires its recovered five-shot burst.

enemies.name: Reconstructionist
descriptions: Ground slam knocks nearby heroes upward; when damaged, repairs itself.
enemies.behavior: Its phase chooses ranked self-repair while wounded, otherwise radial Ground Slam or close Piston Punch.

enemies.name: Reparatron
descriptions: Repairs fallen robots and can use its tools as melee weapons.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-1.

enemies.name: Pack Brawler
descriptions: Cowers alone and uses powerful melee when an ally is nearby.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-1.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Piercing lasers cross multiple heroes; buffs nearby allies’ energy damage.
enemies.behavior: The piercing path damages each contact once and resolves at the selected target, while the support branch applies one ranked Energy Damage buff per 30-second modifier cycle.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Uses energy damage at close range.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-3.

descriptions: Circles its target and periodically darts in for a fast sting.
enemies.behavior: Navigation-clipped circle movement alternates with the recovered Darting Attack.

enemies.behavior: It snapshots the hero’s position, warns there after one second, and damages only actors still inside the strict two-unit radius at 2.5 seconds.

descriptions: Lobs a small sleeping cloud, then closes on sleeping heroes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Sleep Mushroom creates the three-tick radius-two cloud and close targets switch to Rez Melee.

enemies.name: Cannonator
descriptions: Fires a large slow moving projectile when at a distance from his target.
When engaging in close combat, will switch to close range melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: Authored phase order selects the slow projectile beyond eight units and melee at eight or nearer.

enemies.name: Warp Spawner
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.
enemies.behavior: Incoming area damage is reduced by 75 percent and a successful projectile hit performs the recovered random reachable-position teleport.

enemies.name: Ghostly Tracker
descriptions: Has high dodge and damages every hero touched during its charge.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating participates in avoidance and its clipped through-target charge resolves every path contact.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.
enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Ragetusk
descriptions: Charges and knocks heroes up; grows and deals more damage when nearby allies die.
enemies.behavior: The existing charge and knock-up remain, while each nearby allied death now adds a bounded damage and body-size enrage stack.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Attacks with energy damage when up close.
explodes upon death.
Charges its target, explodes upon death
enemies.behavior: Footprint-aware charge pursuit hands off to Smash at close range without rejecting that secondary melee phase, and death starts cast_explode before the recovered 1.3-second, seven-unit elemental-energy detonation at the defeated world position.

enemies.name: Pathogenic Vegevore
descriptions: Fires projectiles that inflicts a disease that can jump between nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its projectile can apply the ranked disease, whose retained run spreads among nearby heroes subject to the authored immunity interval.

enemies.name: Menace Weed
descriptions: Roots to channel healing near allies; otherwise fires rapid thorns.
enemies.behavior: The ally-dependent phase selects its repeated six-unit heal aura or its ranked multishot Thorn Dart.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Necrodactyl
descriptions: The curse deals damage over time, but has a limit on how much it can stack.
enemies.behavior: Projectile impacts apply the six-second curse, repeated hits refresh it and stack its damage only to the authored maximum of three.

enemies.name: Arachno Striker
descriptions: Slow homing projectiles terrify heroes, then it chases terrified victims into melee.
enemies.behavior: The projectile applies Fear and the phase selects close melee against the affected target.

enemies.name: Carrion Shambler
descriptions: Can consume the corpses of its allies to become larger and stronger.
Uses its large fists to smash heroes in melee range.
enemies.behavior: It claims and consumes eligible allied corpses, gaining stacked damage and body scale, and otherwise uses its multi-target frontal melee.

enemies.name: Ragetusk
descriptions: Charges and knocks heroes up; grows and deals more damage when nearby allies die.
enemies.behavior: The existing charge and knock-up remain, while each nearby allied death now adds a bounded damage and body-size enrage stack.

enemies.name: Dimensionist
descriptions: Creates a lasting sphere that slows heroes and projectiles, then calls debris down while protected.
enemies.behavior: Slow Shield uses a removable 16-second globe, Meteor flows into the authored 12-unit target-facing strafe, distant targets are pursued, and the intermediate range admits either packaged laugh/taunt animation.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.
enemies.behavior: It revives the nearest eligible encounter corpse at 40 percent health; without one, it backs away from a close hero and fires the ranked GhostlyBolt projectile before checking for another corpse. The flee pursuit is an explicit secondary phase, so the primary resurrection-family guard no longer releases it as incompatible.

enemies.name: Strafing Drakon
descriptions: Moves and attacks faster near members of its own species.
enemies.behavior: Another living Drakon inside ten units grants a 25-percent movement increase and 25-percent shorter attack cadence.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.
enemies.behavior: It deterministically selects the nearest living ally inside range 30, falls back to itself only when alone, applies the exact 20-second movement/attack/cooldown haste, then fires its recovered projectile.

enemies.name: Magnetic Master
descriptions: Support enemy who tries to stay away from close combat.
Mastery of gravity allows him to pull heroes towards his friends.
Can send out a circular gravitational push that damages and knocks back all nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: It pulls a distant retained hero toward its formation and switches at five units or nearer to the seven-unit damaging push, displacing every admitted nearby hero away from itself.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.
enemies.behavior: Its acid projectile, rank-shaped Energy Defense, bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle movement, half-health Physical-immunity Turtle phase, and ranked poison pulses are active.

enemies.name: Strafing Drakon
descriptions: Moves and attacks faster near members of its own species.
enemies.behavior: Another living Drakon inside ten units grants a 25-percent movement increase and 25-percent shorter attack cadence.

enemies.name: Homing Striker
descriptions: Fires erratically tracking projectiles that periodically home toward the closest hero and expire shortly.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-2.

enemies.name: Warp Spawner
descriptions: Resists area attacks and teleports heroes hit by its projectiles.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-2.

enemies.name: Magnetic Master
descriptions: Avoids melee, pulls heroes toward allies, and emits a damaging circular push.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-2.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Fires piercing lasers and greatly buffs nearby allies' Energy damage.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 2-1.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Hastes a nearby ally's movement and attack speed and fires a moderate projectile.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-1.

enemies.name: Chrono Striker
descriptions: Tail strikes slow movement and attacks; it flees when nearby members of its species die.
enemies.behavior: Its melee applies the timed movement/attack slow, while the nearby-death counter drives its navigation-clipped flee phase.

enemies.name: Ghostly Tracker
descriptions: Has high dodge and damages every hero touched during its charge.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating participates in avoidance and its clipped through-target charge resolves every path contact.

enemies.name: Necrodactyl
descriptions: Lobs a small-area stacking curse that deals damage over time.
enemies.behavior: Its lob applies the bounded ranked poison stack and timed ticks.

enemies.name: Arachno Striker
descriptions: Slow homing projectiles terrify heroes, then it chases terrified victims into melee.
enemies.behavior: The projectile applies Fear and the phase selects close melee against the affected target.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Avoids physical attacks, silences heroes with charges, and drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 2-2.

enemies.name: Pterodyne
descriptions: Stealths to close distance and makes heroes vulnerable to future Physical damage.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 2-2.

enemies.name: Hover-Bot
descriptions: Connects to other Hover-Bots with damaging laser beams.
enemies.behavior: Its persistent paired-beam run damages every hero or companion crossing each link.

enemies.name: Pouncing Stalker
descriptions: Leaps to close distance and can resurrect when killed at the wrong time.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-4.

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
descriptions: Fires slow shadowbolts and strafes between attacks.
enemies.behavior: Matches through the bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle behavior audited in 2-2.

enemies.name: Electron Burster
descriptions: Instant lightning attack fizzles against nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its phase maintains the recovered minimum range, publishes the fizzle when crowded, and otherwise fires the instant beam.

enemies.name: Toxiraptor
descriptions: Connected melee attacks can inject poison.
enemies.behavior: Every accepted surviving hit rolls the ranked chance and applies or refreshes the authored damage-over-time modifier.

enemies.name: Quadrakiller
descriptions: Fires lightning-orb volleys and becomes exhausted briefly afterward.
enemies.behavior: Its recovered four-shot burst retains the long release/exhaustion interval before the next action.

enemies.name: Terrorsaur
descriptions: Throws a spread of fireballs that ignite heroes.
enemies.behavior: Ranked spread angles each resolve independently and accepted hits apply the burning damage-over-time modifier.

enemies.name: Ray Killer
descriptions: Fires one fast horizontal piercing bolt per target in range and flees when struck.
enemies.behavior: A cast now targets every live hero or companion in range with its own piercing bolt, and an accepted incoming hit queues a navigation-clipped flee before the next volley.

enemies.name: Ghostly Tracker
descriptions: Has high dodge and damages every hero touched during its charge.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating participates in avoidance and its clipped through-target charge resolves every path contact.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Pterodyne
descriptions: Will stealth in an attempt to move in close.
Melee attacks cause the hero to become vulnerable to future physical damage.
enemies.behavior: Stealth Attack relocates into its target-relative band and chains Fear Nova; its ordinary melee applies the ranked charge-limited Physical Vulnerability modifier.

enemies.name: Molten Crawler
descriptions: Hurls magma at nearby heroes to create damaging lava pools and uses melee close up.
enemies.behavior: Its phase selects per-target retained lava pools or the recovered melee fallback.

enemies.name: Pouncing Stalker
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.
enemies.behavior: It chooses the authored leap outside Swipe range and its persistent self-resurrection sign now consumes the first lethal hit, restores it at 40 percent health, and resumes combat once.

enemies.name: Dimensionist
descriptions: Creates a lasting sphere that slows heroes and projectiles, then calls debris down while protected.
enemies.behavior: Slow Shield uses a removable 16-second globe, Meteor flows into the authored 12-unit target-facing strafe, distant targets are pursued, and the intermediate range admits either packaged laugh/taunt animation.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.
enemies.behavior: It revives the nearest eligible encounter corpse at 40 percent health; without one, it backs away from a close hero and fires the ranked GhostlyBolt projectile before checking for another corpse. The flee pursuit is an explicit secondary phase, so the primary resurrection-family guard no longer releases it as incompatible.

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
descriptions: Fires slow ranged projectiles and strafes sideways between attacks.
enemies.behavior: Ranked Poison Spit alternates with one bounded navigation-clipped lateral strafe or a short idle before the next attack.

enemies.name: Ray Killer
descriptions: Fires one fast horizontal piercing bolt per target in range and flees when struck.

enemies.name: Sting Raider
descriptions: Fast flying swarm attacker whose shifted form strongly resists area attacks.
enemies.behavior: Its fast close melee remains and an area hit now activates the shifted state on the correct noun family, reducing subsequent area damage while active.

enemies.name: Homing Striker
descriptions: Fires projectiles that periodically home in on the closest hero.
The projectiles will expire after a short period of time.
enemies.behavior: Its retained-target projectile begins homing after one second and is bounded by the authored 18-unit lifetime.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.
enemies.behavior: It deterministically selects the nearest living ally inside range 30, falls back to itself only when alone, applies the exact 20-second movement/attack/cooldown haste, then fires its recovered projectile.

enemies.name: Laser Unit
descriptions: Charges up, then fires a piercing laser bolt.
enemies.behavior: Its ranked wind-up leads into a range-extended piercing projectile.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pull victims are slowed, then struck with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: The three-second Pulled modifier owns the forced-movement interval, then the phase uses the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe while Puller cools.

enemies.name: Molten Crawler
descriptions: Hurls magma at nearby heroes to create damaging lava pools and uses melee close up.
enemies.behavior: Its phase selects per-target retained lava pools or the recovered melee fallback.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.
enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Decelerator
descriptions: Can instantly inflict a crippling debuff on nearby heroes, slowing their movement and attack speed.
Chases after slowed heroes and uses a physical melee attack.
enemies.behavior: Its six-second slow now enters the modifier inventory, reaches the client with the exact movement and attack operands, and contributes its movement operand to authoritative hero motion before the melee pursuit.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.
enemies.behavior: Its acid projectile, rank-shaped Energy Defense, bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle movement, half-health Physical-immunity Turtle phase, and ranked poison pulses are active.

enemies.name: Sting Raider

enemies.name: Dimensionist

enemies.behavior: Slow Shield uses a removable 16-second globe, Meteor flows into the authored 12-unit target-facing strafe, distant targets are pursued, and the intermediate range admits either packaged laugh/taunt animation.

enemies.behavior: Its close-range eight-tick channel heals from committed damage, then its authored channel lifecycle releases before the next attack.

enemies.name: Vampiric Leaper
descriptions: Hopping area effect attack
enemies.behavior: Its authored leap lands with a four-unit area attack against every admitted hero and targetable companion.

enemies.name: Carrion Shambler

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
descriptions: Fires slow ranged projectiles and strafes sideways between attacks.
enemies.behavior: Ranked Poison Spit alternates with one bounded navigation-clipped lateral strafe or a short idle before the next attack.

enemies.name: Tentacler
descriptions: Causes spiky thorns to emerge from underneath a hero..
Damage can be avoided by staying mobile.
enemies.behavior: It snapshots the hero’s position, warns there after one second, and damages only actors still inside the strict two-unit radius at 2.5 seconds.

enemies.name: Caustic Stinger
descriptions: Circles its target and periodically darts in for a fast sting.
enemies.behavior: Navigation-clipped circle movement alternates with the recovered Darting Attack.

enemies.name: Menace Weed
descriptions: Roots to channel healing near allies; otherwise fires rapid thorns.
enemies.behavior: The ally-dependent phase selects its repeated six-unit heal aura or its ranked multishot Thorn Dart.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Reparatron

enemies.behavior: It resurrects an eligible nearby robot through the repair channel and otherwise attacks with Arc Welding melee.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.

At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.
enemies.behavior: Its acid projectile, rank-shaped Energy Defense, bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle movement, half-health Physical-immunity Turtle phase, and ranked poison pulses are active.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.

enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Pouncing Stalker
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.

enemies.behavior: It chooses the authored leap outside Swipe range and its persistent self-resurrection sign now consumes the first lethal hit, restores it at 40 percent health, and resumes combat once.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis
descriptions: Lobs a small sleeping cloud, then closes on sleeping heroes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Sleep Mushroom creates the three-tick radius-two cloud and close targets switch to Rez Melee.

enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Undermind
descriptions: Ignites heroes, increases their Energy vulnerability, and gives allies a fiery buff.
enemies.behavior: Its fiery strike applies burning and stacking Energy vulnerability and projects the allied Energy-damage buff.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.
enemies.behavior: Its acid projectile, rank-shaped Energy Defense, bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle movement, half-health Physical-immunity Turtle phase, and ranked poison pulses are active.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Warp Spawner
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.
enemies.behavior: Incoming area damage is reduced by 75 percent and a successful projectile hit performs the recovered random reachable-position teleport.

enemies.name: Arachno Striker
descriptions: Slow homing projectiles terrify heroes, then it chases terrified victims into melee.
enemies.behavior: The projectile applies Fear and the phase selects close melee against the affected target.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pull victims are slowed, then struck with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: The three-second Pulled modifier owns the forced-movement interval, then the phase uses the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe while Puller cools.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.
enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Undermind
descriptions: Ignites heroes, increases their Energy vulnerability, and gives allies a fiery buff.
enemies.behavior: Its fiery strike applies burning and stacking Energy vulnerability and projects the allied Energy-damage buff.

enemies.name: Decelerator
descriptions: Can instantly inflict a crippling debuff on nearby heroes, slowing their movement and attack speed.
Chases after slowed heroes and uses a physical melee attack.
enemies.behavior: Its six-second slow now enters the modifier inventory, reaches the client with the exact movement and attack operands, and contributes its movement operand to authoritative hero motion before the melee pursuit.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Cannonator
descriptions: Fires a large slow moving projectile when at a distance from his target.
When engaging in close combat, will switch to close range melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: Authored phase order selects the slow projectile beyond eight units and melee at eight or nearer.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.
enemies.behavior: It deterministically selects the nearest living ally inside range 30, falls back to itself only when alone, applies the exact 20-second movement/attack/cooldown haste, then fires its recovered projectile.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Piercing lasers cross multiple heroes; buffs nearby allies’ energy damage.
enemies.behavior: The piercing path damages each contact once and resolves at the selected target, while the support branch applies one ranked Energy Damage buff per 30-second modifier cycle.

enemies.name: Lightning Stalker
descriptions: Slow-moving long-range orb shooter whose hits can briefly shock.
enemies.behavior: Its ranked projectile carries the authored shock chance and timed stun modifier.

enemies.name: Quadrakiller
descriptions: Fires lightning-orb volleys and becomes exhausted briefly afterward.
enemies.behavior: Its recovered four-shot burst retains the long release/exhaustion interval before the next action.

enemies.name: Swarming Herbipod
descriptions: Stationary until threatened; launches slow, relentlessly homing attacks.
enemies.behavior: Zero locomotion keeps the turret stationary, its aggro presentation activates it, and its bounded projectile uses delayed retained-target homing with terminal cleanup even when the target becomes invalid or takes no damage.

enemies.name: Pathogenic Vegevore
descriptions: Disease projectile can jump between nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-4.

enemies.name: Botanical Tunneler
descriptions: Tunnels close underground, then emerges with a poison area attack.
enemies.behavior: Its burrow animation and temporary intangibility accompany pursuit into the eight-unit radial Stagnant Nova.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pull victims are slowed, then struck with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: The three-second Pulled modifier owns the forced-movement interval, then the phase uses the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe while Puller cools.

enemies.name: Toxiraptor
descriptions: Connected melee attacks can inject poison.
enemies.behavior: Every accepted surviving hit rolls the ranked chance and applies or refreshes the authored damage-over-time modifier.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis
descriptions: Lobs a small sleeping cloud, then closes on sleeping heroes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Sleep Mushroom creates the three-tick radius-two cloud and close targets switch to Rez Melee.

enemies.name: Dynosphere
descriptions: Straightforward melee protected by a periodically recharging absorption shield.
enemies.behavior: Its frontal melee is unchanged and its visible rank-shaped absorption shield recharges after 12/10/8 seconds.

enemies.name: Fragbot Mech
descriptions: Highly resistant to energy damage; attacks with rapid-fire machine guns.
enemies.behavior: It publishes rank-shaped 250/500/750 Energy Defense and fires its recovered five-shot burst.

enemies.name: Reconstructionist
descriptions: Ground slam knocks nearby heroes upward; when damaged, repairs itself.
enemies.behavior: Its phase chooses ranked self-repair while wounded, otherwise radial Ground Slam or close Piston Punch.

enemies.name: Reparatron
descriptions: Repairs fallen robots and can use its tools as melee weapons.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-1.

enemies.name: Pack Brawler
descriptions: Cowers alone and uses powerful melee when an ally is nearby.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-1.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Piercing lasers cross multiple heroes; buffs nearby allies’ energy damage.
enemies.behavior: The piercing path damages each contact once and resolves at the selected target, while the support branch applies one ranked Energy Damage buff per 30-second modifier cycle.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Uses energy damage at close range.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-3.

enemies.name: Caustic Stinger
descriptions: Circles its target and periodically darts in for a fast sting.
enemies.behavior: Navigation-clipped circle movement alternates with the recovered Darting Attack.

enemies.name: Tentacler
descriptions: Causes spiky thorns to emerge from underneath a hero..
Damage can be avoided by staying mobile.
enemies.behavior: It snapshots the hero’s position, warns there after one second, and damages only actors still inside the strict two-unit radius at 2.5 seconds.

enemies.name: Chrono Striker
descriptions: Tail strikes slow movement and attacks; it flees when nearby members of its species die.
enemies.behavior: Its melee applies the timed movement/attack slow, while the nearby-death counter drives its navigation-clipped flee phase.

enemies.name: Botanical Tunneler
descriptions: Tunnels close underground, then emerges with a poison area attack.
enemies.behavior: Its burrow animation and temporary intangibility accompany pursuit into the eight-unit radial Stagnant Nova.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pull victims are slowed, then struck with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: The three-second Pulled modifier owns the forced-movement interval, then the phase uses the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe while Puller cools.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis
descriptions: Lobs a small sleeping cloud, then closes on sleeping heroes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Sleep Mushroom creates the three-tick radius-two cloud and close targets switch to Rez Melee.

enemies.name: Cannonator
descriptions: Fires a large slow moving projectile when at a distance from his target.
When engaging in close combat, will switch to close range melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: Authored phase order selects the slow projectile beyond eight units and melee at eight or nearer.

enemies.name: Warp Spawner
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.
enemies.behavior: Incoming area damage is reduced by 75 percent and a successful projectile hit performs the recovered random reachable-position teleport.

enemies.name: Ghostly Tracker
descriptions: Has high dodge and damages every hero touched during its charge.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating participates in avoidance and its clipped through-target charge resolves every path contact.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.
enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Ragetusk
descriptions: Charges and knocks heroes up; grows and deals more damage when nearby allies die.
enemies.behavior: The existing charge and knock-up remain, while each nearby allied death now adds a bounded damage and body-size enrage stack.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Attacks with energy damage when up close.
explodes upon death.
Charges its target, explodes upon death
enemies.behavior: Footprint-aware charge pursuit hands off to Smash at close range without rejecting that secondary melee phase, and death starts cast_explode before the recovered 1.3-second, seven-unit elemental-energy detonation at the defeated world position.

enemies.name: Distracted Mongrel
descriptions: Fast melee attacker that is easily distracted.

enemies.name: Stealth Slayer
descriptions: Appears from stealth beside heroes, then fights in melee.
enemies.behavior: It spawns stealthed, reveals on its first accepted attack or hit, and pursues into close melee.

enemies.name: Pterodyne
descriptions: Stealths to close distance; melee causes future Physical vulnerability.
enemies.behavior: Stealth Attack closes from range and its follow-up melee applies the hit-count vulnerability.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis

enemies.behavior: Audited in 2-1.

enemies.name: Pyro

enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-3.

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
