enemies.name: Pathogenic Vegevore
descriptions: Fires projectiles that inflicts a disease that can jump between nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its projectile can apply the ranked disease, whose retained run spreads among nearby heroes subject to the authored immunity interval.

enemies.name: Menace Weed
descriptions: Roots to channel healing near allies; otherwise fires rapid thorns.
enemies.behavior: The ally-dependent phase selects its repeated six-unit heal aura or its ranked multishot Thorn Dart.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Necrodactyl
descriptions: The curse deals damage over time, but has a limit on how much it can stack.
enemies.behavior: Projectile impacts apply the six-second curse, repeated hits refresh it and stack its damage only to the authored maximum of three.

enemies.name: Arachno Striker
descriptions: Slow homing projectiles terrify heroes, then it chases terrified victims into melee.
enemies.behavior: The projectile applies Fear and the phase selects close melee against the affected target.

enemies.name: Carrion Shambler
descriptions: Can consume the corpses of its allies to become larger and stronger.
Uses its large fists to smash heroes in melee range.
enemies.behavior: It claims and consumes eligible allied corpses, gaining stacked damage and body scale, and otherwise uses its multi-target frontal melee.

enemies.name: Ragetusk
descriptions: Charges and knocks heroes up; grows and deals more damage when nearby allies die.
enemies.behavior: The existing charge and knock-up remain, while each nearby allied death now adds a bounded damage and body-size enrage stack.

enemies.name: Dimensionist
descriptions: Creates a lasting sphere that slows heroes and projectiles, then calls debris down while protected.
enemies.behavior: Slow Shield uses a removable 16-second globe, Meteor flows into the authored 12-unit target-facing strafe, distant targets are pursued, and the intermediate range admits either packaged laugh/taunt animation.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.
enemies.behavior: It revives the nearest eligible encounter corpse at 40 percent health; without one, it backs away from a close hero and fires the ranked GhostlyBolt projectile before checking for another corpse. The flee pursuit is an explicit secondary phase, so the primary resurrection-family guard no longer releases it as incompatible.

enemies.name: Strafing Drakon
descriptions: Moves and attacks faster near members of its own species.
enemies.behavior: Another living Drakon inside ten units grants a 25-percent movement increase and 25-percent shorter attack cadence.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.
enemies.behavior: It deterministically selects the nearest living ally inside range 30, falls back to itself only when alone, applies the exact 20-second movement/attack/cooldown haste, then fires its recovered projectile.

enemies.name: Scorpiod
descriptions: Fast moving, closes in for quick melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: It pursues at the authored eight-unit combat speed and repeats its recovered physical melee on a 1.5-second cooldown.

enemies.name: Homing Striker
descriptions: Fires projectiles that periodically home in on the closest hero.
The projectiles will expire after a short period of time.
enemies.behavior: Its retained-target projectile begins homing after one second and is bounded by the authored 18-unit lifetime.

enemies.name: Tentacler
descriptions: Causes spiky thorns to emerge from underneath a hero..
Damage can be avoided by staying mobile.
enemies.behavior: It snapshots the hero’s position, warns there after one second, and damages only actors still inside the strict two-unit radius at 2.5 seconds.

enemies.name: Warp Spawner
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.
enemies.behavior: Incoming area damage is reduced by 75 percent and a successful projectile hit performs the recovered random reachable-position teleport.

enemies.name: Magnetic Master
descriptions: Support enemy who tries to stay away from close combat.
Mastery of gravity allows him to pull heroes towards his friends.
Can send out a circular gravitational push that damages and knocks back all nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: It pulls a distant retained hero toward its formation and switches at five units or nearer to the seven-unit damaging push, displacing every admitted nearby hero away from itself.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.
enemies.behavior: Its acid projectile, rank-shaped Energy Defense, bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle movement, half-health Physical-immunity Turtle phase, and ranked poison pulses are active.

enemy_class_notes: Static map markers describe encounter loci, not a guaranteed spawned enemy tier.
Elite is a runtime stronger variant with additional affixes; no static E marker is emitted.
Operatives are co-op-only runtime enemies and therefore have no static map marker.
Mutation Agent is labeled A only for an exact authored actor; campaign horde anchors do not imply one.
Captain boss pits occur outside X-4; X-4 boss pits contain Destructors.

enemies.name: Strafing Drakon
descriptions: Moves and attacks faster near members of its own species.
enemies.behavior: Another living Drakon inside ten units grants a 25-percent movement increase and 25-percent shorter attack cadence.

enemies.name: Homing Striker
descriptions: Fires erratically tracking projectiles that periodically home toward the closest hero and expire shortly.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-2.

enemies.name: Warp Spawner
descriptions: Resists area attacks and teleports heroes hit by its projectiles.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-2.

enemies.name: Magnetic Master
descriptions: Avoids melee, pulls heroes toward allies, and emits a damaging circular push.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-2.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Fires piercing lasers and greatly buffs nearby allies' Energy damage.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 2-1.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Hastes a nearby ally's movement and attack speed and fires a moderate projectile.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-1.

enemies.name: Chrono Striker
descriptions: Tail strikes slow movement and attacks; it flees when nearby members of its species die.
enemies.behavior: Its melee applies the timed movement/attack slow, while the nearby-death counter drives its navigation-clipped flee phase.

enemies.name: Ghostly Tracker
descriptions: Has high dodge and damages every hero touched during its charge.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating participates in avoidance and its clipped through-target charge resolves every path contact.

enemies.name: Necrodactyl
descriptions: Lobs a small-area stacking curse that deals damage over time.
enemies.behavior: Its lob applies the bounded ranked poison stack and timed ticks.

enemies.name: Arachno Striker
descriptions: Slow homing projectiles terrify heroes, then it chases terrified victims into melee.
enemies.behavior: The projectile applies Fear and the phase selects close melee against the affected target.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Avoids physical attacks, silences heroes with charges, and drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 2-2.

enemies.name: Pterodyne
descriptions: Stealths to close distance and makes heroes vulnerable to future Physical damage.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 2-2.

enemies.name: Hover-Bot
descriptions: Connects to other Hover-Bots with damaging laser beams.
enemies.behavior: Its persistent paired-beam run damages every hero or companion crossing each link.

enemies.name: Pouncing Stalker
descriptions: Leaps to close distance and can resurrect when killed at the wrong time.
enemies.behavior: Audited in 1-4.

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
descriptions: Fires slow shadowbolts and strafes between attacks.
enemies.behavior: Matches through the bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle behavior audited in 2-2.
